name: Zoomrgy
description: A fully-featured, highly configurable client-side zoom mod. Smooth FOV transitions with adjustable speed and a choice of easing curves (sine, quadratic, cubic, exponential, smoothstep, circular, back, elastic and bounce). Scroll to change magnification on the fly, with a rangefinder HUD, target highlighting and fog reduction. Configurable through Mod Menu. Default keybind: C.
